receipts.last_text_witness: $100,000 isn't just sitting there looking pretty in your account. It's actually the financial equivalent of being pregnant with twins when you thought you were just getting a little chunky. Uh, the math doesn't lie. Even when it seems too good to be true, time and compound interest are working in your favor, but only if you stop making excuses and actually give them the chance to do their job.
